admission.justification: A real stdio test calls an excluded tool before and after listing and requires two errors and two raised-call rows.

applicability: Calls on a role-bound or malformed-bound server to a tool its narrowing removed.
conditions: The call arrives through call_tool, before or after a tools/list.
exclusions: A raised-call row when the tool log cannot be written; the logging stays best-effort.
statement: Calling a tool a bound server excluded fails as an unknown tool without invoking its handler, before or after an explicit tools/list, and records one raised-call row through the existing best-effort path.
